newsitem.title: GERMANY: SOCCER-HAMBURG'S DOWE SET FOR WOLVERHAMPTON.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-HAMBURG'S DOWE SET FOR WOLVERHAMPTON.

text.p: Hamburg midfielder Jens Dowe is set to join Wolverhampton Wanderers of the Enlgish first division on loan for the rest of the season, the German club said on Friday.
"The contract hasn't been signed yet but we think that the move will take place," Hamburg manager Bernd Wehmeyer said.
Dowe fell out of favour at Hamburg after threatening to hit coach Felix Magath at half-time in the first leg of his side's UEFA Cup tie with Celtic in Glasgow.
The 28-year-old, who joined Hamburg from 1860 Munich at the start of the season, had to apologise to Magath and pay a 5,000 mark ($3,200) fine to charity.
